description: This is a PHP class that extends a view component for displaying invoice details in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods to populate invoice template options from the database, generate a popup for template selection, and render HTML for user interaction.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesViewDetail
classes.description: Custom view class for displaying detailed invoice information, including template selection popups.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to include populating templates and displaying popup HTML before calling parent display.

methods.name: populateInvoiceTemplates
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to retrieve invoice template data and updates a global list for dropdown use.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript code for displaying a popup to select report templates, with logic to handle multiple templates or show alert if none exist.
